name: CSV
description: Parse CSV into rows or generate CSV from JSON records.

parameters.name: input_data
parameters.label: Input Data
parameters.description: Parse accepts CSV text and returns { rows, count }; values stay as text. Generate accepts a JSON array of objects (or an expression returning one) and returns { csv, count }. Maximum input/output: 1 MB; maximum rows: 10,000.

parameters.name: header
parameters.label: Header Row
parameters.description: Parse: use the first row as object keys; turn off to return arrays. Generate: include column names as the first row.

parameters.name: escape_formulas
parameters.label: Escape Formulas
parameters.description: Prefixes spreadsheet formulas with an apostrophe.
